apps.name: Manic EMU v2.0.1
apps.subtitle: Love Retro Games
apps.localizedDescription:
Manic EMU is an all-in-one retro emulator for iPhone and iPad. Console, handheld, arcade, computer, and mobile classics live in one library. The app does not include games, BIOS, or game data. Use only legally owned backups, homebrew, or public-domain software.

Supported Platforms

Nintendo
- Nintendo 3DS (3DS)
- Nintendo GameCube (NGC)
- Nintendo Wii (Wii)
- Nintendo 64 (N64)
- Nintendo DS (NDS)
- Game Boy Advance (GBA)
- Game Boy Color (GBC)
- Game Boy (GB)
- Nintendo Entertainment System (NES)
- Famicom Disk System (FDS)
- Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES)
- Virtual Boy (VB)
- Pokemon Mini (PM)

Sony
- PlayStation (PS1)
- PlayStation Portable (PSP)

Sega
- Dreamcast (DC)
- Sega Saturn (SS)
- Sega Master System (MS)
- Game Gear (GG)
- SG-1000 (SG)
- Sega Genesis 32X (32X)
- Sega CD / Mega-CD (MCD)
- Sega Genesis / Mega Drive (MD)

NEC
- PC Engine (PCE)
- TurboGrafx-16 (TG-16)
- TurboGrafx-CD (TG-CD)
- SuperGrafx (SGX)

SNK
- Neo Geo Pocket (NGP)
- Neo Geo Pocket Color (NGPC)

Atari
- Atari 2600
- Atari 5200
- Atari 7800
- Atari Jaguar
- Atari Lynx

Commodore
- Commodore 64 (C64)
- Amiga

Other
- Arcade
- DOOM
- MS-DOS
- Java ME (J2ME)
- Symbian

More systems are planned.

[RetroAchievements]
- Challenge players worldwide and light up trophies that are yours
- Multiset: grind multiple sets on one game — earn subset trophies without patching
- Hardcore Mode: tougher rules, trophies that actually count

[Save States, Your Way]
- Unlimited manual save states plus 50 auto slots
- Save Manager: browse by time, compare, and restore in one tap

[Speed, Cheats & Shortcuts]
- 5x fast forward — you set the pace
- Cheats on demand from an online library
- Custom shortcuts for save, speed, and screenshots

[Filters, Skins & Screenshots]
- Retro filters from our exclusive library
- Skins that feel like real hardware, third-party skins welcome, flex layouts that fit your hands
- Screenshots for the highlight reel

[Landscape Library]
- Landscape console mode — library, covers, and shortcuts on one screen
- Background music and navigation sounds — browsing feels like an arcade
- Browse with a controller or keyboard — stay on the couch

[Play Together]
- Local multiplayer whenever you want
- Eligible cores can host rooms, scan LAN, connect over relay, and spectate

[Cloud Import in One Step]
- Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Baidu Cloud, Aliyun
- WebDAV and SMB too — bring the whole library over in one go

[Controllers Your Way]
- Native Joy-Con, DualShock, and Xbox support
- Bluetooth controllers and keyboards — play on Mac too
- Multiple controllers at once, solo or a full party

[AirPlay — Living Room Ready]
- AirPlay to a TV or display
- Phone to TV without a hitch — couch nights and hangouts
- Big screen plus a controller — immersion maxed out

Privacy Policy: https://manicemu.site/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://manicemu.site/terms-of-use
Official Site: https://manicemu.site
Support: support@manicemu.site

Legal

Manic EMU is not affiliated with Apple or any game or console manufacturer. Platform names describe supported environments only.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Added WonderSwan support
- Added NAOMI, Atomiswave, and System SP arcade support
- Added Flash support
  · Skin button binding
  · Hardware keyboard input
  · Software keyboard input
  · Touch input
- Built-in, self-contained JIT — no external debugger required
- Added Slow Motion
- Improved GameCube and Wii performance
- GameCube now supports multi-disc games
- Improved Wii motion controls
- Simulate the Wii IR pointer by touch
- Add games from other emulators via a link
- Fixed some arcade systems that wouldn’t run
- Fixed Dreamcast games running too fast
- Fixed PSP crashes
- Added NDS lid open/close
- Improved rotation: with orientation lock on in Control Center, the app no longer snaps back to portrait
- In-game shortcut tips can now be turned off
- Landscape library can disable carousel style
- Smoother landscape carousel scrolling
- MultiDisc Helper supports more formats
- Hardware keyboard input for Symbian, Amiga, and C64
- Added RomM support
  · LAN self-hosted servers only
  · Sync only for games imported from RomM
  · Manual sync only, from the service card’s long-press menu
  · Pull ROMs, covers, metadata, manuals, and game saves
- Fixed a launch timeout that could quit the app on older devices
- N64 now supports ROMs larger than 64 MB

apps.name: Regram
apps.subtitle: The all-in-one tweak for Instagram
apps.localizedDescription:
This is an original version, it has original Instagram bundle ID. You need to delete original Instagram before installing. It has Plugins/Extensions removed so it can be signed with free Apple IDs.

Regram is your all-in-one tweak for Instagram. Currently in beta and available only to Patreon subscribers.
Activate license by connecting your Patren account from inside Regram Settings.

Access Regram settings by long-pressing on Home tab bar button or from Instagram settings.

apps.subtitle: The all-in-one tweak for WhatsApp Messenger
apps.localizedDescription:
Watusi is your all-in-one tweak for WhatsApp Messenger.

This is an original version, it has original WhatsApp bundle ID, you need to delete original WhatsApp before installing.

privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This lets you send your current location or nearby places in chats.
privacy.NSLocationTemporaryUsageDescriptionDicti: This lets you send your current location or nearby places in chats.

apps.name: YouTubeRebornPlus
apps.subtitle: Supercharged with a ton of tweaks for the YouTube app.
apps.versionDescription:
Current YouTube IPA: "19.23.3"

RELEASE 20.05.4 - 4.2.9: (2024-06-11)

• YouTubeRebornPlus has YouTube Reborn v4.2.9 integrated.
apps.localizedDescription: YouTube Reborn is the best tweak for customization and video downloading in the YouTube app. Additional features include enhanced PiP options, unlocking higher resolutions, disabling overlays, removing upsell alerts, and more.

privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: This lets you add your own audio files to your videos.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: YouTube needs bluetooth access to scan for nearby Cast devices.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: This lets you create videos using the app.
privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: Your contacts will be sent to YouTube servers to help you find friends to share videos with.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Access to your network allows YouTube to discover and connect to devices such as your TV.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Makes it easier for you to attach location information to your videos and live streams and allows for features such as improved recommendations and ads.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This lets you include audio with your videos and search using your voice.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This lets you upload media you've already created.
privacy.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: A message that informs the user why an app is requesting permission to use data for tracking the user or the device.
